English frequency dictionary (frequency_dictionary_en_82_765.txt)
Unmodified dictionary distributed with SymSpell 6.7.3, embedded into Nook.
The dictionary combines Google Books Ngram frequencies and SCOWL word lists.
Upstream attribution: https://github.com/wolfgarbe/SymSpell/tree/v6.7.3#frequency-dictionary
Google Books Ngram data: http://storage.googleapis.com/books/ngrams/books/datasetsv2.html
Google Books data license: Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/
SCOWL by Kevin Atkinson and contributors: https://wordlist.aspell.net/
Full SCOWL copyright/permission notices are in SCOWL-Copyright.txt.
The dictionary data is not covered solely by SymSpell's MIT code license.

Nook uses bounded one-edit candidate lookup; it does not use automatic compound
rewriting, segmentation, or the larger bigram dictionary. OCR confidence,
literal protection, exact occurrence alignment and visual confusion checks
are Nook-specific policies, not guarantees supplied by SymSpell.
